name: DC-15A blaster rifle
description: The DC-15A blaster rifle, known simply as the DC-15 blaster rifle, was a heavy blaster rifle manufactured by BlasTech Industries, as part of the DC-15 family. It was one of the standard-issue weapons of the Galactic Republic's clone troopers, an army of cloned soldiers in the Grand Army of the Republic, during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The blaster was a larger, heavier, and more powerful long-range alternative to the DC-15A blaster carbine. It was used throughout the Clone Wars by the Republic and its allies, and saw limited use during the early-stages of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

data.name: DC-15A blaster rifle
